text.tspan: Inputs use the RP2040 internal pull-ups (INPUT_PULLUP) and are debounced in firmware. BRIGHT_LO and BRIGHT_HI both HIGH = medium.
Brake = BRAKE_L and BRAKE_R both HIGH (levers squeezed, NC contacts open). A cut wire also reads HIGH, so the brake light fails on.
HEAD_ON and HEAD_STROBE both HIGH = headlight off. D3–D6 form the 4-bar battery gauge (D3 = first bar). Use diffused LEDs behind the PETG window.
